basic_profile.bio: Hi! I'm a 26-year-old software developer living in Austin, Texas. Since the pandemic, I've taken a keen interest in self-improvement and sobriety, which led me to the r/stopdrinking community. Outside of work, I enjoy hiking, exploring new tech gadgets, and participating in local hackathons. I'm single and enjoy spending my evenings gaming or trying out new recipes. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and occasionally during my lunch breaks.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from the University of Texas and have been coding since I was a teenager. My interest in technology naturally led me to learn about cybersecurity, which is why I frequent subreddits like HowToHack. I stay updated with the latest tech trends and enjoy sharing tips and tricks with others.
